previous.observation: Actually viewed new raw return, white/black alpha composites and ORIGINAL full-source master guide. Front open rounded one-fill eyes and tiny closed straight mouth follow the original, not AI-video expression. Source image-left outstretched curled fist, image-right lowered curled hand, crossed legs and ankle-strap shoes are retained. Single ear-side gray/mint lock has two beads, broad continuous compact turns and a complete tapered tip; no white glossy stripe or shaded volume panel. Bob/drill rendering, cap attachment, collar/bow, shoulder frills, cuffs/apron and skin form one coherent drawing. Alpha edges and gaps viewed on black and white, no visible seam or opaque background. Candidate static master only; enlarged first-clip F841..844 placement and adjacent motion require separate review.
